A '''wooden shovel''' is the [[Wooden equipment|wooden]] [[Tools#Shovel|shovel]], crafted from {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. It mines at speed 2 and has 200 durability.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/wooden_shovel.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

The vanilla recipe is blocked and replaced by the pack's own, which sets the stats shown in the infobox.

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Mining ===

It mines shovel blocks at speed 2.

=== Combat ===

It deals 2.5 damage with an attack speed of 1.

=== Repairing ===

It is repaired in an [[anvil]] with {{MCW|Planks|planks}}. The pack keeps the repair cost at zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely (see [[Repairing]]).
